'''Stavrin Hevix''' was a young, relatively unknown [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. Hevix entered the profession not for the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]], but rather because he enjoyed the challenge of setting up elaborate traps for his targets. Hevix always attempted to capture his targets alive.
